what_it_does: Scientific computing libraries like PnetCDF and HDF5 provide high-level interfaces for parallel I/O (input/output) that allow many processors to read and write data simultaneously. Creating data objects requires all processors to coordinate and verify metadata consistency, which becomes expensive as the amount of metadata and number of processors increase. This work introduces a new file format with partitioned metadata blocks, allowing different processors to create objects independently without expensive global coordination overhead.
